'''catman421 Jawas (MISC) (V1)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[catman421]]
* '''Published:''' 28 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber|JP-L-jabbaspalaceaudiencechamber.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PSE Jabba's Palace Audience Chamber cat.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

A tatooine ground deck designed to swarm your opponent with jawas.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

This deck is designed to play only ground tatooine decks.  Get Kalit and Bo Shuda on Audence Chamber to get jawas that are extremely powerful.  Coruscant jawas are better than limited, but both work.  There are two Audence chambers to garentee that you can get one out as your starting location.
